Here’s a concrete plan that fits your constraints and your 3-hour zoo block.

Proposed schedule for Saturday, December 13, 2025 – Minnesota Zoo (3rd grade)

- 8:15–9:00  
  - Normal arrival, morning routines, bathroom, quick expectations for the trip.
- 9:15 – Depart school  
  - Load buses 9:00–9:15.  
  - Assume 35–40 minutes travel.
- ~9:50–10:00 – Arrive at Minnesota Zoo  
  - Bathroom break, divide into groups, quick orientation.
- 10:00–1:00 – At the zoo (3 hours)  
  Example structure:
  - 10:00–11:15: Outdoor areas / targeted exhibits (rotate through 2–3 key areas).  
  - 11:15–11:45: Lunch (indoors if possible; if outdoors, keep it short with warm-up afterward).  
  - 11:45–12:45: Mix of indoor exhibits and one more outdoor loop if weather allows.  
  - 12:45–1:00: Final bathroom stop, souvenir stop if allowed, line up for buses.
- 1:00 – Depart zoo  
  - Back at school ~1:35–1:45.  
  - Leaves buffer before your 2:00 target and well before 3:15 dismissal.
- 1:45–3:15 – Back at school  
  - Debrief, quick reflection writing/drawing, unpack, normal end-of-day.

You can slide these times by 10–15 minutes either direction and still be back by 2:00, but this gives you the full 3 hours on site.
